correctness.rationale: A fresh independent enumeration over all 6^3 student-preference profiles and all 6^3 school-priority profiles reimplemented deferred acceptance and direct Pareto comparison against all six perfect matchings. It reproduced exactly 1296 inefficient profiles; priority histogram {0:42,4:36,8:126,12:12}; rank multiset counts 648 each for (2,2,2) and (2,2,3); and for every inefficient profile exactly one Pareto improvement with exactly two strict beneficiaries. The package verifier additionally cross-checks two DA implementations, stability/student-optimality, a trading-cycle criterion, all 16 strict 2x2 profiles, and the Ergin-cycle classification. The finite claim is therefore exhaustively established rather than inferred from sampling.

final_claim: In balanced complete strict 3x3 school choice with unit capacities, student-proposing deferred acceptance is student-Pareto inefficient on exactly 1296 of 46656 labeled preference-priority profiles (1/36); every inefficient profile has a unique Pareto improvement benefiting exactly two students, the assigned-rank multisets split 648/648 between (2,2,2) and (2,2,3), and across the 216 priority structures the inefficiency counts are 0:42, 4:36, 8:126, 12:12, with the 42 zero cases exactly Ergin-acyclic.
